# Documentation

Durable documentation for this project. GitHub owns status and tracking (Issues, Milestones). This directory owns durable content: specs, plans, ADRs.

- `specs/` — design specs (no status markers).
- `plans/` — implementation plans (checkbox scaffolding is ephemeral).
- `adr/` — architectural decision records (immutable; supersede with a new ADR).
- `superpowers/plans/` — milestone plans from the writing-plans skill.
